decisions.reason: As a newly launched charting add-on with its own product page and rapid follow-up releases, it fits our web-GIS platform strategy and shows active market and development momentum.
The hierarchical search plugin is close to our core web-map offering and strengthens usability for enterprise and public-sector geodata applications with limited diversification risk.
Improving map control on mobile devices is strategically important for customer adoption in field and operational use cases, and the product received prominent homepage visibility at launch.
A platform for building GIS solutions is highly aligned with our long-term direction toward integrated enterprise geospatial solutions and should remain a core product.
Mobile field data capture directly supports practical customer workflows and complements our consulting, integration, and managed geospatial solution business.
A search extension for web map apps is a natural complement to our established application stack and broadens customer value with relatively low strategic and technical risk.
